name: io.github.sepehr071/gamefa-mcp
title: Gamefa
description: Read-only Gamefa (gamefa.com) Persian game and film site: news, scored reviews, profiles, releases.

environmentVariables.name: GAMEFA_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Gamefa requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
